name: Huggi
steps: Rinse the rice and moong dal together until the water runs clear, then drain them well.
Toast the moong dal gently in a heavy pot until fragrant without browning, and add the rice, water and salt.
Cook covered over a gentle heat, stirring occasionally, until the grains soften into a loose savory porridge.
Heat ghee separately; sizzle cumin, crushed pepper, ginger, cashews and curry leaves, then fold this tempering through the hot huggi.
tips: Keep it spoonable with a splash of hot water if it thickens while standing.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
